full_text:
Yarin Doanis

SOFTWARE DEVELOPER

Holon, IL | +972 534324030 | yarin3344s@gmail.com | LinkedIn | GitHub

Profile

Highly motivated Computer Science student with strong skills in backend development and practical exposure to QA and automation frameworks. Eager to contribute across multiple roles, from developing scalable systems to ensuring quality through automated testing

Education

Holon Institute of Technology (HIT) | Holon, IL
B.Sc. in Computer Science (Expected Graduation: 2025)
Relevant Coursework: Algorithms, Data Structures, Object-Oriented Programming, Databases (SQL), Server-Side Development.

Projects

Parking Lot Management System (C#/ .NET) |
• Developed a scalable parking management system for real-time vehicle tracking and price calculation.
• Applied solid OOP principles and integrated SQL data persistence for robust state management.

Weather2Day App (Android, Team of 3) |
• Implemented MVVM architecture with Retrofit and Room for data handling.
• Created background tasks with WorkManager and integrated API calls.
• Managed Dependency Injection setup with Hilt and handled network status dynamically.

Skills

• Languages & Frameworks: Java, Python, C#, JavaScript, SQL, .NET, NodeJS, Express.js, React
• Technologies: CI/CD, RESTful APIs, MySQL, MongoDB, Docker, Git
• Soft Skills: Analytical thinking, problem-solving, team collaboration, adaptability
• Languages: Hebrew (Native), English (Fluent)

Military Service

Workforce Planning Specialist
• Analyzed manpower requirements and optimized resource allocation across military branches.
• Collaborated with team members to meet organizational goals.
